title: Medieval tilers may have beaten Penrose by 500 years
body: In 2007 Peter Lu and Paul Steinhardt showed the girih tile patterns on buildings like Isfahan's 1453 Darb-i Imam shrine embody near-quasicrystalline geometry with self-similar subdivision, centuries before Penrose. The artisans left no theory text, only the work. Craft traditions can encode mathematics nobody wrote down, a caution for histories that equate knowledge with publication.
